audit_metadata.interpretation: status is code-level implementation coverage; cloud_account_presence is deliberately unverified for every row. A semantic key or legacy hint does not prove a live mapping, active account, posting, balance, or correct production behavior.

coverage_basis.exact_code_rule: All workbook leaves are 7-digit design codes. Backend source/migrations use the imported client's legacy chart (mostly 10-digit account codes) resolved through semantic account_map; exact 7-digit workbook code matches are therefore false in this audit.
coverage_basis.covered: An active source module calls a semantic key whose documented expected legacy account corresponds to this business meaning; live mapping/configuration remains unverified.
coverage_basis.partial: A related semantic declaration or generic direct-account path exists, but an event, qualifier, control, policy, or reconciliation dependency is missing.
coverage_basis.missing: No corresponding semantic key/source posting path was found, or the requested meaning has no backend implementation.
coverage_basis.cloud_unverified: No authenticated production read was possible; live account row, is_active/is_group, account_map rows, journals and module data are unknown.
